Order 
This is an application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of BNSS (Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.)
seeking anticipatory bail in connection with FIR/Crime No.796/2024 dated 25.10.2024 registered at Police Station Kolar Road District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2) (N), 366,
506 of IPC.

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant has not committed any offence and he has been falsely implicated in the case.

It is contended by the counsel that the prosecutrix is major which is evident from the statement recorded under Section 183 BNSS in which she clearly stated that she came in touch with the applicant on 28/02/2024 through matrimonial site i.e.
Jeevansathi and they met on number of occasions and had developed physical relation, therefore,
the applicant who is aged about 25 years, deserves to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

3. Per contra, the counsel for the State has opposed the prayer and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:25289 2 MCRC-24333-2025 submitted that under the garb of false promise of marriage as they met through Jeevansathi Site, offence of rape was committed with the prosecutrix.
Therefore, counsel submits that no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out to the applicant.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: A perusal of case diary prima facie reflects that the prosecutrix is major lady and there is consensual relation between them.

5. Thus, taking into consideration the totality of the circumstances of the case and the fact that applicant is aged about 25 years, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of the BNSS.
